faq.q1: How do I place an order on NovaStream?
faq.a1: Select the service and exact option you want on the product page, then click 'Order on WhatsApp'. A prefilled message with your chosen option and price in DH will open so you can confirm availability and payment details with us.
faq.q2: What is the difference between Primary and Secondary access on PlayStation?
faq.a2: For applicable PlayStation services, Primary allows you to play from your own personal console profile, while Secondary is used directly on the provided profile with an active internet connection. Services where this does not apply (such as music subscriptions) do not show these options.
faq.q3: Are the prices displayed in Moroccan Dirhams (MAD)?
faq.a3: Yes, all prices on NovaStream are displayed in Moroccan Dirhams (DH). The exact price is shown as soon as you select a valid option.
faq.q4: How quickly will I receive a response on WhatsApp?
faq.a4: We respond during our daily support hours to confirm current stock availability, explain usage conditions, and guide you step by step.

aboutPage.title: About NovaStream
aboutPage.subtitle: Your transparent digital services & gaming storefront in Morocco.
aboutPage.p1: NovaStream was built to make discovering and comparing digital gaming and entertainment services simple, clear, and accessible for customers across Morocco.
aboutPage.p2: Instead of confusing pricing tables or hidden conditions, our interactive storefront shows you exact prices in Moroccan Dirhams (DH) for every available platform, tier, duration, and access mode.
aboutPage.p3: We prioritize clear communication in Moroccan Darija, French, and English, with direct human assistance via WhatsApp before and after your inquiry.
aboutPage.v1Text: Every variant displays its real database price in Moroccan Dirhams without hidden fees.
aboutPage.v2Text: We explain Primary, Secondary, and plan rules upfront so you know exactly what fits your device.
aboutPage.v3Text: Talk directly with us on WhatsApp in Darija, French, or English to verify stock and setup.

contactPage.title: Contact Us
contactPage.subtitle: Have a question about a service or availability? Reach out on WhatsApp or by email.
contactPage.whatsappCardText: Fastest way to check service availability and ask questions in Darija, French, or English.
contactPage.noteText: Never share your personal console or email passwords in chat. NovaStream will never ask for your personal account password.

legal.privacyContent1: NovaStream respects your privacy. You can browse our entire catalog without creating an account or submitting personal payment details on the website.
legal.privacyContent2: When you click 'Order on WhatsApp', you voluntarily initiate a conversation on WhatsApp using your chosen phone number and prefilled product inquiry. We use a first-party cookie solely to remember your preferred website language (English, French, or Moroccan Darija).
legal.privacyContent3: We do not sell, rent, or share customer contact information with third-party marketers.
legal.termsContent1: All services listed on NovaStream are subject to live availability confirmation via WhatsApp prior to any payment or fulfillment.
legal.termsContent2: Customers must respect the specific usage conditions displayed on each service page (for example, Primary vs Secondary console profile rules or single-screen streaming limits).
legal.termsContent3: All third-party trademarks (such as PlayStation, Xbox, etc.) belong to their respective owners and are used strictly to identify compatible platforms or products.
